items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Fixed some cases of popping and glitching when switching weapons and reloading at extreme angles. Fixed bot pathing issue in Retakes game mode. Fixed a rendering hang on DX11Improved avx / avx512 instruction set detection Miscellaneous stability and performance improvements

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Bomb defusal in Retakes mode will now instantly finish when there is sufficient time remaining in the round and no active utility remains to prevent the defuse. Reduced freeze time and round restart delay in Retakes mode. Pinging pet chickens during freeze time will request a trick from them. Pet chicken names are no longer displayed when customized item text game option is set to hidden. Instance. Precache now accepts entities to precache. Added new top level export Entities. items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Added an option to switch Silent Reload Mode between Hold and Toggle. With toggle enabled, once the silent reload starts you can let go of the reload button. To cancel a silent reload and go back to a fast reload, you can tap the reload button again. Fixed various cases where the first sound of a reload was audible irrespective if a user requested a silent reload or not.. Fixed a bug where liquid could render as black on AMD video cards. Fixed some sound and UI bugs when rewinding during demo playback

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Demo/Replay viewer improvements:. Added a progress bar for demo/replay downloads Camera controls now use click-and-drag scheme Free and chase camera are usable during a paused demo. Fixed some minor issues when seeking to a different position in the demo file. Round backup files now require the game server startup flag "-allow_round_backup_files". Updated AUG reload animations for standing and crouch reloads to better match new reload duration Allowed radio commands now have an explicit list. Added toolsskybox_occluder tool material for CS2 Workshop Tools Stability improvements for Vulkan renderer
